steps.warmUp: Start with the warm-up, as in every singing lesson: a few easy minutes to wake up your voice.
steps.majorScale: Do, re, mi, fa, sol, la, ti, do: the major scale, eight notes from do up to the next do. Most of its steps are whole steps; two are half steps, mi to fa and ti to do. Keep those two small, so they don’t come out too wide.
steps.scaleUp: Up the scale, from do to do. The music waits at each note.
steps.scaleUpDown: Listen, then sing it in time: up the scale and back down.
steps.scaleAlong: The same, singing along with the guide melody.
